tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Lumi coffee shop (downtown Tijuana, Mexico) business details: address, map link, coordinates, opening hours, price range, amenities, services (dine-in, drive-up orders, no delivery), Google rating, contact and social profiles. / Datos del negocio.

tools.name: get_opening_hours
tools.description: Opening hours of Lumi by day of the week (24 h format, America/Tijuana time zone). / Horario por día.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Lumi menu with prices in Mexican pesos (MXN) by category and cup size: coffee bar, seasonal drinks, tonics, frappés, teas, sloshies, specialties, desserts and sandwiches. Optional category slug. / La carta con precios.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Search Lumi menu items by name or ingredient (accent-insensitive, all words must match), optionally only items with a price up to max_price MXN. / Busca productos de la carta.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: Lumi spaces (free meeting room, work areas, private glass room, ~500 m² terrace) with highlights, page URLs and how to book them (WhatsApp, confirmed by a person; no booking API). / Espacios y reservación.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Lumi frequently asked questions with official answers (hours, location, parking, wifi, meeting room, pets, payment…). Optional words to filter. / Preguntas frecuentes.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read any lumicafe.com page as Markdown (the same text as the HTML page, with title, description and URL in the frontmatter), including the articles in /descubre/. Takes the page path or URL, e.g. "/espacios/sala-de-juntas-gratis-tijuana/". / Lee una página del sitio.
